title: Can I Win
description: Determine if the first player can win the game given a pool of integers 1..maxChoosableInteger to reach a target sum.
pseudocode:
1. memo = {}
2. function canWin(desiredTotal, mask):
3.   if memo[mask] != null: return memo[mask]
4.   for i from 1 to maxChoosableInteger:
5.     if not (mask & (1 << (i-1))):
6.       if i >= desiredTotal or not canWin(desiredTotal - i, mask | (1 << (i-1))):
7.         return memo[mask] = true
8.   return memo[mask] = false
